quarterly_data.signal: Lam Research 10-Q, September 2026 quarter (in thousands): revenue by region China $2,885,608 (35%), Korea $1,634,115 (20%; $776,301 a year earlier), Taiwan $1,482,087 (18%; 27% in the June quarter), Japan $721,509, United States $663,102, Southeast Asia $531,694, Europe $301,303. Systems revenue $5,732,907 ($3,547,565 a year earlier; up 35% sequentially on foundry and memory spending) and customer support-related revenue and other $2,486,511. The foundry share rose sequentially on 'the timing of mature node investments within the China region'. Deferred revenue on contracts not yet recognized totalled $2,661,231 thousand ($2,026,932 thousand within one year). Investing cash use was mainly capex for manufacturing capacity and lab infrastructure; headcount approximately 24,300.
